scripts.text: - You hear a faint conversation going on inside. -
scripts.translation: - 你聽到裡面傳來微弱的談話聲。 -

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
Once again, I have failed to
make the ^8B4513Jaty Crown^000000...
I was sure that I could do it this time.
Why won't it work?
scripts.translation:
[部落首領 派科]
又一次了，我沒能打造出^8B4513賈提王冠^000000...
我原本確信這次一定能成功的。
為什麼就是不行呢？

scripts.text:
[Sage Kasyapa]
The ^006400Jaty Crown^000000 has been known to have miraculous power since the time of the ancients.
But it's been said only those who've earned a tribal honor
would be able to use it.
scripts.translation:
[賢者 迦葉]
^006400賈提王冠^000000自古以來就被認為擁有神奇的力量。
但據說只有獲得部落榮譽的人，才能使用它。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
^0000FFKasyapa^000000!!
Are you saying that even though I am the leader of our tribe, I have not yet received that honor?
scripts.translation:
[部落首領 派科]
^0000FF迦葉^000000！！
你是說，雖然我身為部落首領，卻還沒有獲得那份榮譽嗎？

scripts.text:
[Sage Kasyapa]
Calm down ^0000FFChief Paiko^000000...
As the Great and Powerful Chief, you should be more than enough to qualify.
scripts.translation:
[賢者 迦葉]
冷靜點，^0000FF派科首領^000000...
作為偉大而強大的首領，您理應完全符合資格。

scripts.text:
[Sage Kasyapa]
In my younger years I could have easily solved the problem but this old man's mind cannot figure out what's missing.
scripts.translation:
[賢者 迦葉]
在我年輕的時候，我本可以輕鬆解決這個問題，但這老朽的腦子實在想不出還缺了什麼。

scripts.text: The conversation trails off and you don't hear any more.
scripts.translation: 談話聲漸漸遠去，你再也聽不到更多了。

scripts.text: Kasyapa and Chief Paiko begin talking as you are about to leave...
scripts.translation: 就在你準備離開時，迦葉和派科首領開始交談...

scripts.text:
[Sage Kasyapa]
I am unsure of what is missing but that traveler could be big help in creating the ^006400Jaty Crown^000000.
Of this I am certain.
The reason is...
scripts.translation:
[賢者 迦葉]
我不確定還缺了什麼，但那位旅行者或許對打造^006400賈提王冠^000000大有裨益。
對此我深信不疑。
原因是...

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
What is the reason?
scripts.translation:
[部落首領 派科]
原因是什麼？

scripts.text:
[Sage Kasyapa]
This ^8B4513Cendrawasih Feather^000000 was owned by our first tribe leader when the crown was originally created.
It was stored as a treasured heirloom of our tribe.
scripts.translation:
[賢者 迦葉]
這根^8B4513天堂鳥羽毛^000000曾屬於我們部落的第一任首領，也就是當初打造王冠時的人。
它一直被作為部落的珍貴傳家寶儲存著。

scripts.text:
[Sage Kasyapa]
But when the traveler came near, this feather started to shine, and I kept thinking that this is not just a coincidence.
This person will be the key to assisting us to make the crown.
scripts.translation:
[賢者 迦葉]
但當旅行者靠近時，這根羽毛開始發光，我一直覺得這絕非巧合。
這個人將是我們打造王冠的關鍵。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
Could it happen for sure?
If so, I will give everything
to support them...
scripts.translation:
[部落首領 派科]
真的有可能嗎？
如果是這樣，我願意傾盡所有
來支援他...

scripts.text:
[Sage Kasyapa]
Ah, a stranger to our land.
Are you lost?
I hope you did not encounter much danger on your journey here.
scripts.translation:
[賢者 迦葉]
啊，一位來自遠方的旅人。
你是迷路了嗎？
希望你在旅途中沒有遇到太多危險。

scripts.text:
[Sage Kasyapa]
Your earnest expression tells me
that you have something to say
you might as well tell me what it is.
scripts.translation:
[賢者 迦葉]
你誠懇的神情告訴我，
你似乎有話想說，
不妨直接告訴我吧。

scripts.text: I overheard talk about a crown?
scripts.translation: 我好像聽到了關於王冠的談話？

scripts.text: Just looking for the gift shop.
scripts.translation: 只是在找禮品店。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
Really?
It looked as if your eyes
wanted to say something.
scripts.translation:
[部落首領 派科]
真的嗎？
看起來你的眼神
似乎想說什麼。

scripts.text:
[Sage Kasyapa]
Oh, you heard about the crown, eh?
Ah, this old man's got loose lips
we should have used a little more discretion...
scripts.translation:
[賢者 迦葉]
哦，你聽到了關於王冠的事，是嗎？
唉，這老傢伙嘴真快，
我們本該更謹慎一點的...

scripts.text: Anything I can do to help?
scripts.translation: 有什麼我能幫忙的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Sage Kasyapa]
I can see in your eyes
that you are a trustworthy sort... but...
scripts.translation:
[賢者 迦葉]
從你的眼神中，
我能看出你是個值得信賴的人...但是...

scripts.text: There is a brief twinkling of light ^0000FFKasyapa^000000 all of sudden seems to be taken aback.
scripts.translation: ^0000FF迦葉^000000 身上突然閃過一絲微光，他似乎有些驚訝。

scripts.text:
[Sage Kasyapa]
Ah, the feather......!
Instead of talking to me, why don't you talk to our tribe's leader, ^0000FFPaiko^000000.
scripts.translation:
[賢者 迦葉]
啊，羽毛......！
與其和我說話，不如去和我們部落的首領 ^0000FF派科^000000 談談。

scripts.text:
[Sage Kasyapa]
Instead of talking to me, why don't you talk to our tribe's leader, ^0000FFChief Paiko^000000.
scripts.translation:
[賢者 迦葉]
與其和我說話，不如去和我們部落的首領 ^0000FF部落首領 派科^000000 談談。

scripts.text:
[Sage Kasyapa]
If that's what Chief ^0000FFPaiko^000000 wants
I don't have any more to say.
Hmm....
but...... this....
scripts.translation:
[賢者 迦葉]
如果這是 ^0000FF派科^000000 首領的意願，
我無話可說。
嗯....
但是......這個....

scripts.text:
[Sage Kasyapa]
Never mind, please have a good trip.
scripts.translation:
[賢者 迦葉]
算了，祝你旅途愉快。

scripts.text:
[Sage Kasyapa]
I've been waiting for you traveler.
Our tribe's leader has a favor
to ask of you.
Please talk to Chief ^0000FFPaiko^000000.
scripts.translation:
[賢者 迦葉]
我一直在等你，旅行者。
我們部落的首領有一事相求。
請去和 ^0000FF派科^000000 首領談談。

scripts.text:
[Sage Kasyapa]
I heard you could help making a crown
for our tribe leader.
You will certainly be
a big help to us...
I trust my own eyes!
And also the sparkling light...
scripts.translation:
[賢者 迦葉]
我聽說你能幫我們製作一頂
給部落首領的王冠。
你一定會幫大忙的...
我相信自己的眼睛！
還有那閃爍的光芒...

scripts.text:
[Sage Kasyapa]
The symbol of Dayak Tribe
and a famous mystical creature.
Find 15 of ^006400Cendrawasih Feather^000000
and bring them to Chief ^0000FFPaiko^000000.
scripts.translation:
[賢者 迦葉]
這是達雅克部落的象徵，
也是一種著名的神秘生物。
請收集 15 根 ^006400天堂鳥羽毛^000000，
並帶給 ^0000FF派科^000000 首領。

scripts.text:
[Sage Kasyapa]
With the feathers that you have brought creating a ^006400Jaty Crown^000000 is going much more smoothly.
Go see Chief ^0000FFPaiko^000000.
scripts.translation:
[賢者 迦葉]
有了你帶來的羽毛，
製作 ^006400賈提王冠^000000 的過程會順利得多。
去見見 ^0000FF派科^000000 首領吧。

scripts.text:
[Sage Kasyapa]
There is something
I wish to give to you
as a reward for your help.
Please, it would honor us if you would take it.
scripts.translation:
[賢者 迦葉]
作為對你幫助的獎勵，
我想送給你一樣東西。
請收下，這將是我們莫大的榮幸。

scripts.text:
[Sage Kasyapa]
You are carrying too much weight over the limit.
I cannot get you your reward unless you reduce the amount of weighty items you are carrying.
scripts.translation:
[賢者 迦葉]
你攜帶的物品重量超過了上限。
除非你減輕負重，否則我無法給你獎勵。

scripts.text:
[Sage Kasyapa]
You are carrying too much in your inventory.
I will give you the reward once you unburden yourself and return.
scripts.translation:
[賢者 迦葉]
你的背包物品太多了。
等你卸下部分物品後再回來，我會給你獎勵。

scripts.text:
[Sage Kasyapa]
The reason I asked you to embark on this important mission is because of this feather.
Handed down from generation to generation the legendary origin of the crown is this feather...
scripts.translation:
[賢者 迦葉]
我讓你執行這個重要任務，是因為這根羽毛。
這根羽毛代代相傳，王冠的傳奇起源正是它...

scripts.text:
[Sage Kasyapa]
I saw this feather begin to shine when you came here.
I knew you were a person who
would endeavour to help us.
On behalf of my people
I give my thanks.
scripts.translation:
[賢者 迦葉]
當你來到這裡時，我看到這根羽毛開始發光。
我知道你是個願意幫助我們的人。
代表我的族人，
我向你表示感謝。

scripts.text:
[Sage Kasyapa]
Also, the feather you received isn't just valuable on its own, it also is an acknowledgment from our tribe.
scripts.translation:
[賢者 迦葉]
另外，你收到的這根羽毛不僅本身珍貴，
也是對我們部落的認可。

scripts.text:
[Sage Kasyapa]
Like ^8B4513Krakatau^000000 Volcano, when you venture into dangerous areas like that, if you display this feather, you can get help from the tribe.
Anyway, I really thank you.
scripts.translation:
[賢者 迦葉]
就像 ^8B4513喀拉喀托^000000 火山一樣，當你進入那些危險區域時，
展示這根羽毛就能獲得部落的幫助。
總之，真的非常感謝你。

scripts.text:
[Sage Kasyapa]
Also, the feather you received isn't just valuable on its own, it also is an acknowledgment from our tribe.
scripts.translation:
[賢者 迦葉]
另外，你收到的這根羽毛不僅本身珍貴，
也是對我們部落的認可。

scripts.text:
[Sage Kasyapa]
Like ^8B4513Krakatau^000000 Volcano, when you venture into dangerous areas like that, if you display this feather, you can get help from the tribe.
Anyway, I really thank you.
scripts.translation:
[賢者 迦葉]
就像 ^8B4513喀拉喀托^000000 火山一樣，當你進入那些危險區域時，
展示這根羽毛就能獲得部落的幫助。
總之，真的非常感謝你。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
I am the leader of this tribe
^0000FFPaiko^000000
scripts.translation:
[部落首領 派科]
我是這個部落的首領
^0000FF派科^000000

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
I can see you are a traveler,
from another land.
What brings you here?
scripts.translation:
[部落首領 派科]
我看你是個來自異鄉的旅行者。
是什麼風把你吹到這裡來了？

scripts.text: I overheard the story by accident
scripts.translation: 我偶然聽到了那個故事

scripts.text: I have nothing to say.
scripts.translation: 我沒什麼好說的。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
You are wasting your time here.
There are many other attractions around our village.
scripts.translation:
[部落首領 派科]
你在這裡浪費時間了。
我們村莊周圍有很多其他景點。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
What do you mean?
You heard the story about a crown?
You must have heard incorrectly.
I have nothing to say to you
regarding such things.
scripts.translation:
[部落首領 派科]
你什麼意思？
你聽到了關於王冠的故事？
你一定是聽錯了。
關於這種事，我沒什麼好對你說的。

scripts.text: Kasyapa was talking about a crown...
scripts.translation: 迦葉在談論王冠...

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
It seems that ^0000FFKasyapa^000000 has told you a tall tale and I appreciate your concern about our affairs.
scripts.translation:
[部落首領 派科]
看來 ^0000FF迦葉^000000 給你講了些誇張的故事，感謝你對我們事務的關心。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
It's not something that a stranger like you could understand so make like a tree, and get out of here.
scripts.translation:
[部落首領 派科]
這不是像你這樣的外人能理解的，像棵樹一樣，從這裡滾出去吧。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
There are many other attractions around our village.
scripts.translation:
[部落首領 派科]
我們村莊周圍有很多其他景點。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
If it's about the crown I want you to stop asking about it.
Please leave.
scripts.translation:
[部落首領 派科]
如果是關於王冠的事，我勸你不要再問了。
請離開。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
I've been waiting for you, traveler
according to sage ^0000FFKasyapa^000000
You are willing to help us make a crown for our tribe.
scripts.translation:
[部落首領 派科]
我一直在等你，旅行者，
根據賢者 ^0000FF迦葉^000000 的說法，
你願意幫助我們為王族製作一頂王冠。

scripts.text: Crown-a-whatsis?
scripts.translation: 王冠？什麼王冠？

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
The Tribe leader has the duty of making and protecting the ^006400Jaty Crown^000000 to uphold the tribe's pride and honor.
scripts.translation:
[部落首領 派科]
部落首領有責任制作並守護 ^006400賈提王冠^000000，以維護部落的尊嚴與榮譽。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
But, ever since I became the tribe leader there have been difficulties making it.
scripts.translation:
[部落首領 派科]
但是，自從我成為部落首領以來，製作它一直困難重重。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
According to Sage ^0000FFKasyapa^000000, you can help us create a ^006400Jaty Crown^000000.
scripts.translation:
[部落首領 派科]
根據賢者 ^0000FF迦葉^000000 的說法，你可以幫助我們打造一頂 ^006400賈提王冠^000000。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
Do you think you can help?
Your efforts will not go unrewarded.
scripts.translation:
[部落首領 派科]
你覺得你能幫上忙嗎？
你的付出不會沒有回報。

scripts.text: Ok, I will help
scripts.translation: 好的，我會幫忙

scripts.text: I am sorry, I cannot help now.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我現在無法幫忙。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
That's really sad.
If you ever change
your mind, please
come again.
I will be waiting.
scripts.translation:
[部落首領 派科]
這真的很遺憾。
如果你改變主意，
請再來。
我會在這裡等你。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
Many thanks to you, stranger
If Kasyapa trusts you then I know that you can help us make a
^006400Jaty Crown^000000
What you can do to
help us is very simple.
scripts.translation:
[部落首領 派科]
非常感謝你，陌生人。
既然迦葉信任你，我就知道你能幫助我們打造一頂
^006400賈提王冠^000000
你要做的幫助非常簡單。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
The symbol of the Jaty Tribe is also a famous mystical creature.
Find 15 ^006400Cendrawasih Feather^000000s and bring them to me.
Our faith is in you, stranger.
scripts.translation:
[部落首領 派科]
賈提部落的象徵也是一種著名的神秘生物。
找到15根 ^006400天堂鳥羽毛^000000 並帶給我。
我們信任你，陌生人。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
It seems that you have yet to find the materials to make the ^006400Jaty Crown^000000.
scripts.translation:
[部落首領 派科]
看來你還沒有找到製作 ^006400賈提王冠^000000 的材料。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
The symbol of the Dayak Tribe is also a famous mystical creature.
Find 15 ^006400Cendrawasih Feather^000000s and bring them to me.
scripts.translation:
[部落首領 派科]
達雅克部落的象徵也是一種著名的神秘生物。
找到15根 ^006400天堂鳥羽毛^000000 並帶給我。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
Oh! You've found all of them. Look! The feathers you have found are sparkling. Aren't they?
Alright, let me begin crafting the ^006400Jaty Crown^000000 I feel that I am ready.
scripts.translation:
[部落首領 派科]
哦！你全都找到了。看！你找到的羽毛閃閃發光，不是嗎？
好了，讓我開始打造 ^006400賈提王冠^000000 吧。我感覺我已經準備好了。

scripts.text: Suddenly, a large noise begins to boom as you and ^0000FFPaiko^000000 are surrounded by warm and bright sparkling energy like a thousand tinkling fireflies.
scripts.translation: 突然，巨大的轟鳴聲響起，你和 ^0000FF派科^000000 被溫暖而明亮的閃光能量包圍，宛如一千隻閃爍的螢火蟲。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
With your help the ^006400Jaty Crown^000000 is coming along nicely.
It will take some time until the task is finished so please wait a little.
scripts.translation:
[部落首領 派科]
多虧你的幫助，^006400賈提王冠^000000 的打造進展順利。
完成這項任務還需要一些時間，請稍等片刻。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
After the ^006400Jaty Crown^000000 is complete, there is a gift that I want to give to you.
scripts.translation:
[部落首領 派科]
等 ^006400賈提王冠^000000 完成後，我有一份禮物想送給你。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
Ah, also you should go see Sage ^0000FFKasyapa^000000 who really wants to reward you with something.
scripts.translation:
[部落首領 派科]
啊，對了，你應該去見見賢者 ^0000FF迦葉^000000，他很想獎勵你些什麼。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
Ah, you should talk to Sage ^0000FFKasyapa^000000 who really wants to reward you with something.
scripts.translation:
[部落首領 派科]
啊，你應該去和賢者 ^0000FF迦葉^000000 對話，他很想獎勵你些什麼。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
With your support I am not worrying about creating the ^006400Jaty Crown^000000.
I really appreciate it.
scripts.translation:
[部落首領 派科]
有了你的支援，我對打造 ^006400賈提王冠^000000 不再擔心。
我真的很感激。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
A delightful day like today should be celebrated. Don't you think?
So I prepared to sample the special food of our tribe, called ^006400Satay^000000
scripts.translation:
[部落首領 派科]
像今天這樣美好的一天應該慶祝一下，你覺得呢？
所以我準備了我們部落的特色美食，叫做 ^006400沙嗲^000000

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
But, this ^006400Satay^000000 is too tasty for just the two of us to share so we would like to share it with people out in the village.
scripts.translation:
[部落首領 派科]
但是，這份 ^006400沙嗲^000000 太美味了，只夠我們兩個人分享，所以我想把它分享給村子裡的人們。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
What do you think?
In order to share news that
the ^006400Jaty Crown^000000 is being successfully crafted and to share the delicious ^006400Satay^000000 with our friends, I need your help.
scripts.translation:
[部落首領 派科]
你覺得怎麼樣？
為了分享 ^006400賈提王冠^000000 成功打造的訊息，並與我們的朋友分享美味的 ^006400沙嗲^000000，我需要你的幫助。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
Are you up for a short delivery job?
scripts.translation:
[部落首領 派科]
你願意接受一個短途的配送任務嗎？

scripts.text: Of course, I can help
scripts.translation: 當然，我可以幫忙

scripts.text: Sorry, I am too busy to help.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我太忙了，無法幫忙。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
I believed you would definitely help me...
It's a little disappointing.
If you ever change your mind
come speak with me again.
scripts.translation:
[部落首領 派科]
我相信你一定會幫我的...
這有點令人失望。
如果你改變主意，
再來和我對話吧。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
Oh!, I knew you'd help.
Our tribe's warriors come to my mind before we share with anyone else.
Please share Satay with the warriors in the village.
scripts.translation:
[部落首領 派科]
哦！我就知道你會幫忙。
在我們分享給其他人之前，我想到了我們部落的戰士。
請把沙嗲分享給村子裡的戰士。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
For the moment I will give you 2 ^006400Satay^000000.
scripts.translation:
[部落首領 派科]
暫時先給你2份 ^006400沙嗲^000000。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
You may be tempted by the aroma of our ^006400Satay^000000 and you may eat one but, if you eat more than that you won't be able to share the ^006400Satay^000000
with our village friends.
scripts.translation:
[部落首領 派科]
你可能會被我們 ^006400沙嗲^000000 的香氣誘惑而吃掉一份，但如果你吃多了，就無法把 ^006400沙嗲^000000
分享給村裡的朋友了。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
Our tribe warriors come to my mind to deliver the food to share Satay with warriors in the village.
scripts.translation:
[部落首領 派科]
我想到了我們部落的戰士，去把食物送到村裡，與戰士們分享沙嗲。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
Ah, the next person whom I want the ^006400Satay^000000 delivered to is someone who stays across from the river, the ^0000FFTribe Manager^000000.
scripts.translation:
[部落首領 派科]
啊，下一個我想讓 ^006400沙嗲^000000 送達的人是住在河對岸的 ^0000FF部落管理員^000000。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
To this end, I will give you 2 more servings of ^006400Satay^000000.
scripts.translation:
[部落首領 派科]
為此，我再給你2份 ^006400沙嗲^000000。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
If you are attracted by the aroma of the ^006400Satay^000000, you may eat one but, if you eat more you won't be able to share ^006400Satay^000000 with our friends.
scripts.translation:
[部落首領 派科]
如果你被 ^006400沙嗲^000000 的香氣吸引，可以吃一份，但吃多了就無法把 ^006400沙嗲^000000 分享給我們的朋友了。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
Second person to be delivered ^006400Satay^000000 is someone who stays across the river.
scripts.translation:
[部落首領 派科]
第二個要送達 ^006400沙嗲^000000 的人是住在河對岸的人。

scripts.text:
That is the ^0000FFTribe Manager^000000.
Please deliver it to them before it cools down.
scripts.translation:
那就是 ^0000FF部落管理員^000000。
請在它涼掉之前送過去。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
Oh, you have delivered it already?
The third person to deliver the ^006400Satay^000000 to is the ^0000FFGatekeeper of Krakatau Volcano^000000.
scripts.translation:
[部落首領 派科]
哦，你已經送完了？
第三個要送達 ^006400沙嗲^000000 的人是 ^0000FF喀拉喀托火山守門人^000000。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
I'll give you 2 more servings of ^006400Satay^000000 for this delivery.
scripts.translation:
[部落首領 派科]
為了這次配送，我再給你2份 ^006400沙嗲^000000。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
And just like before, don't give into the smell and try not to eat the ^006400Satay^000000.
scripts.translation:
[部落首領 派科]
和之前一樣，別被香味誘惑，儘量別吃 ^006400沙嗲^000000。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
The third person to deliver the ^006400Satay^000000 to is the ^0000FFGatekeeper of Krakatau Volcano^000000.
Please deliver it before it cools down.
scripts.translation:
[部落首領 派科]
第三個要送達 ^006400沙嗲^000000 的人是 ^0000FF喀拉喀托火山守門人^000000。
請在它涼掉之前送過去。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
Oh, You have delivered it
Last person to deliver ^006400Satay^000000 to is the ^0000FFBorobudur Temple Manager^000000 who is on ^8B4513Dewata Island^000000.
scripts.translation:
[部落首領 派科]
哦，你已經送完了？
最後一個要送達 ^006400沙嗲^000000 的人是位於 ^8B4513德瓦他島^000000 的 ^0000FF婆羅浮屠神廟管理員^000000。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
I will give you 2 more ^006400Satay^000000
scripts.translation:
[部落首領 派科]
我再給你2份 ^006400沙嗲^000000。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
And just like before, don't give into the smell and try not to eat the ^006400Satay^000000.
scripts.translation:
[部落首領 派科]
和之前一樣，別被香味誘惑，儘量別吃 ^006400沙嗲^000000。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
The last person to be delivered ^006400Satay^000000 is
^0000FFBorobudur Temple Manager^000000 who is in
^8B4513Dewata Island^000000.
Please deliver it before it cools down.
scripts.translation:
[部落首領 派科]
最後一個要送達 ^006400沙嗲^000000 的人是
位於 ^8B4513德瓦他島^000000 的
^0000FF婆羅浮屠神廟管理員^000000。
請在它涼掉之前送過去。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
Oh, you have delivered it.
You've done good work.
It has been a good time for all of us to share and enjoy this happy occasion together. Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[部落首領 派科]
哦，你已經送完了。
你做得很好。
大家能一起分享並享受這個快樂的時刻，真是太好了。謝謝你。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
While you were on the way back from delivering the ^006400Satay^000000,
the Jaty Crown has been made. Its ambience and radiance make it a truly flawless crown.
scripts.translation:
[部落首領 派科]
在你送完 ^006400沙嗲^000000 回來的路上，
賈提王冠已經做好了。它的氣場和光澤使其成為一頂真正完美的王冠。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
Also, you brought more than enough materials so after making the ^006400Jaty Crown^000000, we were able to craft a similar one for you to keep.
scripts.translation:
[部落首領 派科]
另外，你帶來的材料非常充足，所以在製作 ^006400賈提王冠^000000 之後，我們還為你製作了一頂類似的作為紀念。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
It's not the same as the original, but it has its own specialty. It is my reward to thank you for what you have done.
scripts.translation:
[部落首領 派科]
它和原版不完全一樣，但也有其獨特之處。這是我為了感謝你所做的一切而給你的獎勵。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
You are carrying too much weight to receive your reward.
Please reduce your carried weight and come back again.
scripts.translation:
[部落首領 派科]
你攜帶的物品太重了，無法領取獎勵。
請減輕負重後再回來。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
Made with our tribe's secret marinade try the ^006400Satay^000000.
It was made with all our heart, especially for you, but don't forget to share it with friends.
scripts.translation:
[部落首領 派科]
這是用我們部落的秘密醃料製作的 ^006400沙嗲^000000。
我們傾注了全部的心意，特別是為你做的，但別忘了和朋友分享。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
You've done good work.
Whatever you do in the future, I wish for you to have a life which is full of fortune and joy.
As Chief of the ^8B4513Jaty Tribe^000000, I wish you the best of luck!!
scripts.translation:
[部落首領 派科]
你做得很好。
無論未來你做什麼，我都祝你生活充滿幸運和喜悅。
作為 ^8B4513賈提部落^000000 的首領，我祝你一切順利！！

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
It seems that you have yet to deliver the ^006400Satay^000000.
Did you run into any problems?
scripts.translation:
[部落首領 派科]
看來你還沒有送達 ^006400沙嗲^000000。
遇到什麼問題了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
Haven't you delivered the ^006400Satay^000000 yet?
Anything go wrong?
scripts.translation:
[部落首領 派科]
你還沒送達 ^006400沙嗲^000000 嗎？
出什麼事了嗎？

scripts.text: I ate them all.
scripts.translation: 我全吃光了。

scripts.text: Deliver to whom.
scripts.translation: 送給誰？

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 沒什麼。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
Huh... so you couldn't resist yourself, eh?
Don't blame yourself too much. It is difficult to resist the ^006400Satay^000000's addicting aroma.
scripts.translation:
[部落首領 派科]
啊……看來你沒能抵擋住誘惑呢？
別太自責了。^006400沙嗲^000000那令人上癮的香氣確實很難抗拒。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
Our tribe is short on food supplies so we can't give out more of our ^006400Satay^000000, but there's a rumor that the restaurant owner in Dewata Island is making and selling their own ^006400Satay^000000.
scripts.translation:
[部落首領 派科]
我們部落的糧食儲備不足，無法再提供 ^006400沙嗲^000000 了。
不過有傳聞說，德瓦他島上的餐廳老闆正在製作並出售他們自制的 ^006400沙嗲^000000。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
It is not as tasty as our tribe's recipe, but this is an urgent task so just find it and deliver it.
scripts.translation:
[部落首領 派科]
雖然味道不如我們部落的秘方，但這是緊急任務，所以只要找到並送達即可。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
Alright! Deliver it right now!
scripts.translation:
[部落首領 派科]
很好！現在立刻去送達！

scripts.text:
[Jaty Tribe Warrior]
We revere strength and bravery.
We are ^FF0000Jaty^000000 Tribe.
scripts.translation:
[雅提部落戰士]
我們崇尚力量與勇氣。
我們是 ^FF0000雅提^000000 部落。

scripts.text:
[Jaty Tribe Warrior]
My trained eyes see that
you seem about to say something.
Speak, and state your business.
scripts.translation:
[雅提部落戰士]
我這雙訓練有素的眼睛看出，
你似乎有話要說。
請講，說明你的來意。

scripts.text: ^0000FFTribal Chief Paiko^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000FF部落首領 派科^000000

scripts.text:
[Jaty Tribe Warrior]
I've heard about your
helpful deeds...
As a representative of my tribe
I express my thanks to you.
scripts.translation:
[雅提部落戰士]
我聽說過你的善舉……
作為我部落的代表，
我向你表示感謝。

scripts.text:
[Jaty Tribe Warrior]
Also, thank you for the ^006400Satay^000000
My mouth is already watering thank you.
There is something I would like to share with you regarding our tribe.
scripts.translation:
[雅提部落戰士]
另外，謝謝你帶來的 ^006400沙嗲^000000，
我已經口水直流了，謝謝。
關於我們的部落，我有件事想與你分享。

scripts.text:
[Jaty Tribe Warrior]
Unlike the ancient times when our tribe's warriors fought and shed their blood the world has become more peaceful nowadays but our tribe's territory has shrunk drastically.
scripts.translation:
[雅提部落戰士]
不像古代我們部落的戰士在戰鬥中流血犧牲，如今世界變得更加和平，但我們部落的領地卻急劇縮小了。

scripts.text:
[Jaty Tribe Warrior]
Nevertheless we will continue keeping the warrior tradition of our tribe alive and we will preserve the pride we have earned through the sacrifice of those past warriors.
scripts.translation:
[雅提部落戰士]
儘管如此，我們將繼續傳承部落的戰士傳統，並守護那些過去戰士用犧牲換來的榮耀。

scripts.text:
[Jaty Tribe Warrior]
I hope that your perseverance and pride remain with you in your travels.
scripts.translation:
[雅提部落戰士]
希望你的堅持與驕傲能伴隨你的旅途。

scripts.text:
[Tribe Manager]
Keeping our culture and tradition is very important.
Although it is a little boring...
scripts.translation:
[部落管理員]
保持我們的文化和傳統非常重要。
雖然有點無聊……

scripts.text:
[Tribe Manager]
Keeping our culture and tradition is very important.
scripts.translation:
[部落管理員]
保持我們的文化和傳統非常重要。

scripts.text:
[Tribe Manager]
It seems to me that you have something
to say, don't you?
scripts.translation:
[部落管理員]
看來你似乎有話要說，不是嗎？

scripts.text: ^0000FFTribal Chief Paiko^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000FF部落首領 派科^000000

scripts.text:
[Tribe Manager]
I didn't know that there was
such an effort being put forth
and that you took a key role in the effort...
You are the hero of the^8B4513Jaty Tribe^000000.
scripts.translation:
[部落管理員]
我不知道竟然有如此的努力，
而且你在其中扮演了關鍵角色……
你是 ^8B4513雅提部落^000000 的英雄。

scripts.text:
[Tribe Manager]
Wow~ the savory scent of
delicious homemade ^006400Satay^000000!!
Thank you for the meal.
Please give my regards
to our Tribe Leader.
scripts.translation:
[部落管理員]
哇~ 自制 ^006400沙嗲^000000 的誘人香氣！！
謝謝你的款待。
請代我向我們的部落首領致意。

scripts.text:
[Tribe Manager]
There are few contacts between
^8B4513Dewata Island^000000 and ^8B4513Jaty tribe^000000.
We used to have a stronger bond
in older times.
scripts.translation:
[部落管理員]
^8B4513德瓦他島^000000 和 ^8B4513雅提部落^000000 之間的往來很少。
在更早的時候，我們的聯絡更緊密。

scripts.text:
[Tribe Manager]
But with new culture and foreigners flowing in
^8B4513Dewata Island^000000 has became a tourist attraction and we have lost touch with them.
scripts.translation:
[部落管理員]
但隨著新文化和外來者的湧入，
^8B4513德瓦他島^000000 變成了一個旅遊景點，
我們與那裡的聯絡也就斷絕了。

scripts.text:
[Tribe Manager]
The tourist attraction has expanded continuously but the reason it hasn't influenced us here is due to this small temple which I am managing.
scripts.translation:
[部落管理員]
旅遊景點不斷擴大，
但它之所以沒有影響到我們這裡，
是因為我管理的這座小寺廟。

scripts.text:
[Tribe Manager]
I couldn't let our tradition fade away like that easily.
I hope keeping our tradition and culture alive lets people know how important these things are to us.
scripts.translation:
[部落管理員]
我不能讓我們的傳統就這樣輕易消失。
我希望通過保持傳統和文化的活力，
讓人們知道這些對我們有多重要。

scripts.text:
[Tribe Manager]
From now on, I hope people from ^8B4513Dewata Island^000000 and ^8B4513Jaty Tribe^000000 can get along and interact more often.
scripts.translation:
[部落管理員]
從現在起，我希望 ^8B4513德瓦他島^000000 和 ^8B4513雅提部落^000000 的人們
能和睦相處，更頻繁地互動。

scripts.text:
[Gatekeeper of Krakatau Volcano]
^8B4513Krakatau Volcano^000000 is
a very dangerous area
I cannot allow anyone to go in there.
scripts.translation:
[喀拉喀托火山守門人]
^8B4513喀拉喀托火山^000000 是一個非常危險的區域，
我不能讓任何人進去。

scripts.text: Allow me through
scripts.translation: 讓我通過

scripts.text: I don't want to go in{0}
scripts.translation: 我不想去{0}

scripts.text:
[Gatekeeper of Krakatau Volcano]
^8B4513Krakatau Volcano^000000 is
a very dangerous area
so I can't allow you in
unless you qualify for entry.
scripts.translation:
[喀拉喀托火山守門人]
^8B4513喀拉喀托火山^000000 是一個非常危險的區域，
除非你符合進入資格，
否則我不能讓你進去。

scripts.text:
[Gatekeeper of Krakatau Volcano]
You are the traveler who was acknowledged by tribe leader as a friend of the tribe and received a ^006400Shining Cendrawasih Feather^000000.
scripts.translation:
[喀拉喀托火山守門人]
你是被部落首領認可為部落朋友，
並獲得了 ^006400華麗天堂鳥羽毛^000000 的旅行者。

scripts.text:
[Gatekeeper of Krakatau Volcano]
Well, I will let you pass but ^8B4513Krakatau Volcano^000000 is dangerous so please take care.
scripts.translation:
[喀拉喀托火山守門人]
好吧，我讓你通過，
但 ^8B4513喀拉喀托火山^000000 很危險，
請小心。

scripts.text:
[Gatekeeper of Krakatau Volcano]
You have chosen wisely.
^8B4513Krakatau Volcano^000000 is
an extremely dangerous area.
scripts.translation:
[喀拉喀托火山守門人]
你選擇得很明智。
^8B4513喀拉喀托火山^000000 是一個極其危險的區域。

scripts.text:
[Gatekeeper of Krakatau Volcano]
Oh! I didn't know about that!
This is some of the best news
I have heard recently.
scripts.translation:
[喀拉喀托火山守門人]
噢！我不知道這件事！
這是我最近聽到的最好的訊息。

scripts.text:
[Gatekeeper of Krakatau Volcano]
Um, what is this wonderful smell?
Of course, it's our ^006400Satay^000000!
I was slightly hungry
so this should fill me up.
scripts.translation:
[喀拉喀托火山守門人]
嗯，這是什麼美妙的香味？
當然是我們的 ^006400沙嗲^000000 ！
我有點餓了，
這應該能讓我吃飽。

scripts.text:
[Gatekeeper of Krakatau Volcano]
Since you came all the way here
I will share you an interesting story.
scripts.translation:
[喀拉喀托火山守門人]
既然你大老遠來到這裡，
我要給你講一個有趣的故事。

scripts.text:
[Gatekeeper of Krakatau Volcano]
It has become a lost tradition in recent years but until 10 or more years ago in order to become a ^8B4513Jaty Tribe^000000 warrior you had to climb Krakatau Volcano to prove your endurance.
scripts.translation:
[喀拉喀托火山守門人]
近年來這已成為失傳的傳統，
但在10多年前，為了成為 ^8B4513雅提部落^000000 的戰士，
你必須攀登喀拉喀托火山來證明你的耐力。

scripts.text:
[Gatekeeper of Krakatau Volcano]
The eyes of those warriors were anxious yet determined before going up ^8B4513Krakatau Volcano^000000.
scripts.translation:
[喀拉喀托火山守門人]
那些戰士在登上 ^8B4513喀拉喀托火山^000000 之前，
眼神中充滿了焦慮，卻又堅定無比。

scripts.text:
[Gatekeeper of Krakatau Volcano]
I still cannot forget that look in their eyes I feel a little bit the same emotion from you Adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[喀拉喀托火山守門人]
我至今無法忘記他們眼中的那種神情，
我在你身上，冒險者，也感受到了一絲同樣的情感。

scripts.text:
[Gatekeeper of Krakatau Volcano]
I want you to live long and prosper.
Be healthy and safe, traveler so you can live to tell the tale of your adventures.
scripts.translation:
[喀拉喀托火山守門人]
我希望你長壽且繁榮。
保持健康和安全，旅行者，
這樣你才能活下來講述你的冒險故事。

scripts.text:
[Gatekeeper of Krakatau Volcano]
Want to go back
to Dewata?
scripts.translation:
[喀拉喀托火山守門人]
想回德瓦他嗎？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Gatekeeper of Krakatau Volcano]
^8B4513Krakatau Volcano^000000 is
a dangerous place.
You should go back now.
scripts.translation:
[喀拉喀托火山守門人]
^8B4513喀拉喀托火山^000000 是一個危險的地方。
你應該現在回去。

scripts.text:
[Borobudur Temple Manager]
The weather today is so beautiful.
scripts.translation:
[婆羅浮屠神廟管理員]
今天天氣真好。

scripts.text:
[Borobudur Temple Manager]
By the way, do you have
something to tell me...?
scripts.translation:
[婆羅浮屠神廟管理員]
對了，你有什麼事要告訴我嗎...？

scripts.text: ^0000FFTribal Chief Paiko^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000FF部落首領 派科^000000

scripts.text:
[Borobudur Temple Manager]
I never knew such a thing had happened.
If you had told me in advance, I could have helped at least a little bit.
Still things have gone well with your help.
scripts.translation:
[婆羅浮屠神廟管理員]
我竟然不知道發生了這樣的事。
如果你提前告訴我，我至少能幫上一點忙。
不過多虧了你，事情還是順利解決了。

scripts.text:
[Borobudur Temple Manager]
Ah, it is the ^006400Satay^00000 that I sampled when the tribe invited me some time ago.
scripts.translation:
[婆羅浮屠神廟管理員]
啊，這是之前部落邀請我品嚐過的^006400沙嗲^00000。

scripts.text:
[Borobudur Temple Manager]
Good~~ This is the same taste I remember.
To give my thanks I will pass along a story that may interest you
scripts.translation:
[婆羅浮屠神廟管理員]
好吃~~ 還是我記憶中的那個味道。
為了表示感謝，我講一個你可能感興趣的故事吧。

scripts.text:
[Borobudur Temple Manager]
Legend tells of a strange bird called ^FF0000Garuda^000000.
It has the torso, arms and legs of a human but has the head and beak of an eagle.
scripts.translation:
[婆羅浮屠神廟管理員]
傳說有一種奇怪的鳥，名叫^FF0000迦樓羅^000000。
它擁有人類的軀幹、手臂和雙腿，但長著鷹的頭和喙。

scripts.text:
[Borobudur Temple Manager]
The Story of this bird describes it helping the gods exterminate wicked demons and snakes.
scripts.translation:
[婆羅浮屠神廟管理員]
關於這隻鳥的故事說，它曾幫助眾神消滅邪惡的惡魔和蛇。

scripts.text:
[Borobudur Temple Manager]
The tale has been passed down from generation to generation.
Quite interesting, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[婆羅浮屠神廟管理員]
這個故事代代相傳。
挺有意思的，不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Borobudur Temple Manager]
I am sure in the village of the ^8B4513Jaty Tribe^000000 there are many legendary stories.
When I get to meet the Chief, I will hear many such stories for sure.
scripts.translation:
[婆羅浮屠神廟管理員]
我確信在^8B4513賈提部落^000000的村莊裡有很多傳奇故事。
等我見到首領時，一定會聽到許多這樣的故事。

scripts.text:
[Borobudur Temple Manager]
I am not certain of when we will cross paths again but I hope we will meet again someday.
I wish you a pleasant journey, young traveler.
scripts.translation:
[婆羅浮屠神廟管理員]
我不確定我們何時會再次相遇，但希望有一天我們能重逢。
祝你旅途愉快，年輕的旅行者。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
Why are you carrying so much? Doesn't that hurt your back?
scripts.translation:
[備忘]
你背了這麼多東西？不累嗎？

scripts.text:
[Memo]
Is it a trend for youngsters to carry heavy things?
scripts.translation:
[備忘]
現在年輕人流行背重物嗎？

scripts.text:
[Memo]
Will you help me again tomorrow?
Poby still has a back pain.
Backaches don't just go away after one day.
scripts.translation:
[備忘]
明天你還會來幫忙嗎？
波比還在背痛。
背痛不是一天就能好的。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
Dewata is always crowded but today is quiet.
scripts.translation:
[備忘]
德瓦他總是很熱鬧，但今天卻很安靜。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
Oh god! We don't have a message from the Jaty tribe yet.
scripts.translation:
[備忘]
天哪！我們還沒收到賈提部落的訊息。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
They have never broken a promise for 10 years, I do not know the reason. What's happening?
scripts.translation:
[備忘]
他們十年來從未失約過，我不知道原因。發生什麼事了？

scripts.text:
[Memo]
I might spoil all the liquid if it is going on like this.
scripts.translation:
[備忘]
如果一直這樣下去，所有的液體都要變質了。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
What should I do? I still don't have any news from the Jaty tribe.
scripts.translation:
[備忘]
我該怎麼辦？我還是沒收到賈提部落的訊息。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
Oh no~ All the liquid is going to spoil...
scripts.translation:
[備忘]
糟糕~ 所有的液體都要變質了...

scripts.text: What happened?
scripts.translation: 發生了什麼？

scripts.text:
[Memo]
Who are you?
scripts.translation:
[備忘]
你是誰？

scripts.text:
[Memo]
You are an adventurer, right?
As you can see from the jars around me, I am making ^0000FFtraditional wine^000000 for a living.
scripts.translation:
[備忘]
你是冒險者，對吧？
從周圍這些罐子就能看出來，我是靠釀造^0000FF傳統葡萄酒^000000為生的。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
Everyone knows about this, so ^0000FFDewata island^000000 attracts many tourists.
scripts.translation:
[備忘]
大家都知道這一點，所以^0000FF德瓦他島^000000吸引了很多遊客。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
Especially this traditional wine, which has been made for four generations! But ^FF0000Ark^000000 is short of supply.
Ark needs ^0000FFPalm Oils^000000, made from Oil Palm Fruit.
scripts.translation:
[備忘]
尤其是這款傳統葡萄酒，已經傳承了四代！但是^FF0000阿克^000000的供應不足。
阿克需要^0000FF棕櫚油^000000，它是用油棕果製成的。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
Unfortunately, we haven't been getting ^0000FFPalm Oil^000000 from the Jaty tribe village lately.
The ingredients might be useless if it is delivered too late.
scripts.translation:
[備忘]
不幸的是，最近賈提部落的村莊沒有送來^0000FF棕櫚油^000000。
如果送得太晚，原料可能會失效。

scripts.text: Sounds like a big problem.
scripts.translation: 聽起來是個大問題。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
It is more of a problem than you think. Sales are credit, but if we do not make due today, we'll lose the credit, the ingredients, and the tourists who do not get the Ark. So it's quite damaging.
scripts.translation:
[備忘]
這比你想像的要嚴重得多。銷售是賒賬的，但如果今天不按時交貨，我們就會失去信用、原料，以及那些沒拿到阿克的遊客。所以損失相當大。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
Ah, right! Are you busy now?
scripts.translation:
[備忘]
啊，對了！你現在忙嗎？

scripts.text: Sorry, I am busy.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我很忙。

scripts.text: No, I am not busy.
scripts.translation: 不，我不忙。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
Hmm, I have no choice.
You don't care that others are in trouble. What has this world come to?
scripts.translation:
[備忘]
嗯，我別無選擇。
你根本不在乎別人的困境。這世界變成什麼樣了？

scripts.text:
[Memo]
That's good to hear.
So since you are wandering here...
scripts.translation:
[備忘]
聽到你這麼說真好。
既然你正好在這裡閒逛...

scripts.text:
[Memo]
Do you mind if I ask you a favor~? Actually I have to visit the Jaty Tribe, but this unmatured ^FF0000Ark^000000 won't let me leave.
scripts.translation:
[備忘]
你介意幫我個忙嗎~？其實我得去一趟賈提部落，但這些未成熟的^FF0000阿克^000000讓我走不開。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
Will you go to Jaty village and ask ^0000FFLero^000000 what happened?
scripts.translation:
[備忘]
你能去賈提村莊問問^0000FF萊羅^000000發生了什麼嗎？

scripts.text:
[Memo]
This guy has never broken a promise for 10 years, so he must have a really good reason not to come.
scripts.translation:
[備忘]
這傢伙十年來從未失約，所以這次不來肯定有非常充分的理由。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
Find the best oil master.
His name again is ^0000FFLero^000000.
scripts.translation:
[備忘]
去找最好的榨油大師。
他的名字是^0000FF萊羅^000000。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
So, what did Lero say?
scripts.translation:
[備忘]
那麼，萊羅怎麼說？

scripts.text:
[Memo]
You didn't find out what happened?
scripts.translation:
[備忘]
你沒查出發生了什麼嗎？

scripts.text:
[Memo]
Find the best oil master. His name is ^0000FFLero^000000.
scripts.translation:
[備忘]
去找最好的榨油大師。他的名字是^0000FF萊羅^000000。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
So, what did Lero say?
scripts.translation:
[備忘]
那麼，萊羅怎麼說？

scripts.text: Palm tree... became.
scripts.translation: 棕櫚樹...變成了。

scripts.text: - You explain the situation to Mr. Memo -
scripts.translation: - 向備忘說明情況 -

scripts.text:
[Memo]
Lero said sorry?
Hmm, it's okay.
scripts.translation:
[備忘]
萊羅說抱歉？
嗯，沒關係。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
That must be ^0000FFPoby^000000. If he has been hurt, that's why there wasn't any message. Lero actually cares about him a lot...
scripts.translation:
[備忘]
那一定是^0000FF波比^000000。如果他受傷了，那就解釋為什麼沒有訊息了。萊羅其實很關心他...

scripts.text:
[Memo]
He might be troublesome, but please visit the Jaty village. Lero must complete the oil.
scripts.translation:
[備忘]
他可能有點麻煩，但請去賈蒂村莊。萊羅必須完成榨油。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
If it is not, wait there and bring ^FF000030 bottles of oil^000000 to me.
scripts.translation:
[備忘]
如果不行，就在那裡等著，並帶^FF000030瓶油^000000給我。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
He might be troublesome, but please visit the Jaty village. Lero must complete the oil.
scripts.translation:
[備忘]
他可能有點麻煩，但請去賈蒂村莊。萊羅必須完成榨油。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
If it is not, wait there and bring ^FF000030 bottles of oil^000000 to me.
scripts.translation:
[備忘]
如果不行，就在那裡等著，並帶^FF000030瓶油^000000給我。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
Oh, didn't I tell you to bring 30 bottles of oil? Did you forget?
scripts.translation:
[備忘]
哦，我沒告訴過你要帶30瓶油嗎？你忘了？

scripts.text:
[Memo]
Go back to Lero and get more, he will give you more if it was your mistake.
scripts.translation:
[備忘]
回去找萊羅再要一些，如果是你的失誤，他會再給你的。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
You brought the oil. Good job, and thank you.
scripts.translation:
[備忘]
你帶來了油。幹得好，謝謝。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
Excuse me, but I have an urgent matter to attend to. Can you wait for a while and talk to me when I'm done?
scripts.translation:
[備忘]
抱歉，我有急事要處理。你能稍等片刻，等我忙完再和我說話嗎？

scripts.text: - Memo is making an ark. -
scripts.translation: - 備忘正在製作方舟。 -

scripts.text: - There is error in the quest. -
scripts.translation: - 任務出現錯誤。 -

scripts.text:
[Memo]
Did I make you wait too long?
scripts.translation:
[備忘]
讓你久等了？

scripts.text:
[Memo]
My family has been making Arks for four generations.
scripts.translation:
[備忘]
我家已經制作方舟四代了。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
Grandfather had a hard living since he didn't get many good sales.
scripts.translation:
[備忘]
祖父因為生意不好，生活很艱難。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
Dewata island people do not drink much in the hot weather.
scripts.translation:
[備忘]
德瓦他島的人在炎熱天氣裡不怎麼喝酒。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
When I was young, Dewata developed as a tourist attraction and that's when the ^FF00FFtour package^000000 Ark started selling well.
scripts.translation:
[備忘]
我小時候，德瓦他發展成了旅遊景點，那時^FF00FF旅遊套餐^000000方舟開始暢銷。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
Good liquid needs fresh oil. I was able to make liquid for ten years and deliver it all on time.
scripts.translation:
[備忘]
好的液體需要新鮮的油。我能夠製作液體十年，並按時交付所有訂單。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
Because today's oil has not arrived on time, I think I might have a hard time.
scripts.translation:
[備忘]
因為今天的油沒有按時到達，我想我可能會遇到困難。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
You helped me to make the liquid correctly.
scripts.translation:
[備忘]
謝謝你幫我正確地製作了液體。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
This proverb ^0000FF'Mengatakan mudah, mengerjakan susah.'^000000 means it is easy to say something but hard to do anything.
scripts.translation:
[備忘]
這句諺語^0000FF“Mengatakan mudah, mengerjakan susah.”^000000的意思是，說容易，做難。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
In other words, it's easy to say that we'll help others but it's hard to actually do the action.
scripts.translation:
[備忘]
換句話說，嘴上說願意幫助別人很容易，但真正付諸行動卻很難。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
You really did a great job. I like you because you are different from today's youngins.
scripts.translation:
[備忘]
你做得真棒。我喜歡你，因為你和現在的年輕人不一樣。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
Will you help me with my work from time to time?
I will pay you for what you do for me.
scripts.translation:
[備忘]
你願意時不時來幫我幹活嗎？
我會付你報酬的。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
{0}, to what do I owe the pleasure?
scripts.translation:
[備忘]
{0}，有什麼事嗎？

scripts.text: Just came by to say hello.
scripts.translation: 只是來打個招呼

scripts.text: I will help you.
scripts.translation: 我會幫您的。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
I guess you are busy.
If possible, will you get the oil from Lero? I will appreciate it...
scripts.translation:
[備忘]
看來你很忙。
如果方便的話，能去幫我把油從萊羅那裡取回來嗎？我會感激不盡的...

scripts.text:
[Memo]
Thank you. I know that you're busy and helping me can be a chore.
scripts.translation:
[備忘]
謝謝你。我知道你很忙，幫我這個忙可能很麻煩。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
Can you help Lero and bring back palm tree oil...?
scripts.translation:
[備忘]
你能幫萊羅的忙，把棕櫚油帶回來嗎...

scripts.text:
[Memo]
Can you help Lero and bring back palm tree oil...?
scripts.translation:
[備忘]
你能幫萊羅的忙，把棕櫚油帶回來嗎...

scripts.text:
[Memo]
You haven't brought enough oil.
scripts.translation:
[備忘]
你帶的油不夠。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
Poby owes me a few things, he'll give you some.
scripts.translation:
[備忘]
波比欠我一些東西，他會給你的。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
Oh you brought the oil, good job.
scripts.translation:
[備忘]
哦，你把油帶來了，幹得好。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
You must've had a hard time bringing the oil so here take this drink.
scripts.translation:
[備忘]
你帶油一定很辛苦，拿這個喝吧。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
Ark is famous for tourists, a guy bought many bottles by himself.
scripts.translation:
[備忘]
方舟以遊客聞名，有個傢伙一個人買了很多瓶。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
Worrying that he'll drink alone? Too much drink always becomes poisonous.
scripts.translation:
[備忘]
擔心他一個人喝？喝太多酒總會變成毒藥的。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
The sun always rises in the East. The well known laziness wakes up early in the morning.
scripts.translation:
[備忘]
太陽總是從東方升起。那個出了名的懶散的人一大早就醒了。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
Does he come to reality? He is good but lazy.
scripts.translation:
[備忘]
他來到現實世界了嗎？他人不錯，但很懶。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
The first blow is half the battle.
scripts.translation:
[備忘]
好的開始是成功的一半。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
I think that you're destined to do great things.
scripts.translation:
[備忘]
我覺得你註定要做大事。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
There's a man saying blow hot and cold, it seems that a word is easy but it is not.
scripts.translation:
[備忘]
有人說他出爾反爾，看來承諾雖輕，踐行卻難。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
I believe that you will hold true to your promise.
scripts.translation:
[備忘]
我相信你會信守承諾。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
I want you to help me this time.
scripts.translation:
[備忘]
這次我想請你幫個忙。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
Poby still has back pains and it will take some days for him to recover.
scripts.translation:
[備忘]
波比還在腰疼，需要幾天才能恢復。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
Dewata island is always crowded but today is quiet.
scripts.translation:
[備忘]
德瓦他島總是很熱鬧，但今天卻很安靜。

scripts.text:
[Lero]
You're carrying too many things...
scripts.translation:
[萊羅]
你帶了太多東西...

scripts.text:
[Lero]
Oh no! I have so many orders and I'm running out of ingredients.
Not yet? What's going on, Poby? Where did he go?
scripts.translation:
[萊羅]
糟糕！訂單太多，原料快用完了。
還沒回來嗎？怎麼回事，波比？他去哪了？

scripts.text: Excuse me, but are you Lero?
scripts.translation: 打擾一下，請問你是萊羅嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lero]
When Poby gets back here, I'm gonna give him a beating he'll never forget!
scripts.translation:
[萊羅]
等波比回來，我要給他一頓讓他終生難忘的教訓！

scripts.text: - Lero seems pretty mad at someone and ignores you -
scripts.translation: - 萊羅似乎對某人很生氣，無視了你 -

scripts.text:
[Lero]
Oops. Who are you?
scripts.translation:
[萊羅]
哎呀。你是誰？

scripts.text: Memo sent me here.
scripts.translation: 備忘派我來的。

scripts.text:
[Lero]
Ah, right! I forgot about Memo because the workers who gather nuts have not come yet. Sorry.
scripts.translation:
[萊羅]
啊，對！我忘了備忘的事，因為去採堅果的工人還沒回來。抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Lero]
To make fresh palm oils, I need fresh Palm Oil Fruit. Then I'll be able to get more fresh oil from its fresh fruit.
scripts.translation:
[萊羅]
要製作新鮮棕櫚油，我需要新鮮棕櫚果實。這樣我就能從新鮮果實中榨出更多新鮮油。

scripts.text:
[Lero]
Between you and me, Mr. Memo is so fussy that he will not use any unfresh oil.
scripts.translation:
[萊羅]
說句悄悄話，備忘先生很挑剔，他不用不新鮮的油。

scripts.text:
[Lero]
To make fresh oil, he always sends the workers to palm tree forest, but... the guys sent at dawn have not come back yet.
scripts.translation:
[萊羅]
為了製作新鮮油，他總是派工人去棕櫚樹林，但...黎明時分派去的人還沒回來。

scripts.text:
[Lero]
First, I thought that he was lazy and it made me very uneasy.
Can you find the workers in the palm forest?
scripts.translation:
[萊羅]
起初，我以為他是太懶了，這讓我很不安。
你能去棕櫚樹林找找工人嗎？

scripts.text: Yes, I will find them.
scripts.translation: 好的，我會找到他們。

scripts.text:
[Lero]
Thank you so much.
Find Poby.
scripts.translation:
[萊羅]
非常感謝。
去找波比。

scripts.text:
[Lero]

Oh... Sorry~ Sorry. I was so happy that I finally arrived at Dewata Island.

[加蒂]
哦...抱歉~抱歉。我太高興了，終於到達德瓦他島了。

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
This is not a short story. Oh! I have to introduce myself first. I am Mastersmith Gatti, also an Adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
這不是個短故事。哦！我得先自我介紹。我是神工匠加蒂，也是一名冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
I found a mysterious Weapon blueprint, but I don't remember exactly when I acquired it.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
我找到了一張神秘的武器藍圖，但我記不清具體是什麼時候得到的了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Weapon Blueprint?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
武器藍圖？

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
Yes! I traveled all around to find the materials for the weapon, but...
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
是的！我四處奔波尋找製造這件武器的材料，但是...

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
I couldn't find the last material anywhere.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
我在任何地方都找不到最後一種材料。

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
I was about to give up, but there was some fine print on the blueprint saying that it could be found on the Dewata Island.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
我差點要放棄了，但藍圖的角落裡有一行小字，說可以在德瓦他島找到。

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
I don't know why somebody put such an important thing in fine print. Anyway, after reading that, I invested all my fortunes to find that Island.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
我不知道為什麼有人會把這麼重要的事寫在小字裡。總之，看到那行字後，我投入了所有的積蓄去尋找那座島。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh... Is that so?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦...原來是這樣？

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
This island is strange. I arrived here a week ago, and everybody here has been avoiding me.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
這座島很奇怪。我一週前到達這裡，但這裡的人都在躲著我。

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
Last week was so hard, but you saved me by telling me this is Dewata Island.
Thank you for telling me, and thank you for passing here at just the right time.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
上週過得很艱難，但你告訴我這裡是德瓦他島，救了我一命。
謝謝你告訴我，也謝謝你在恰當的時候路過這裡。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Uh... No problem.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
呃...沒什麼大不了的。

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
Well... There was a little problem of my ship getting wrecked, but that's neither here nor there.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
嗯...雖然我的船沉了，但這都是小事一樁。

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
Now that I found out this is Dewata Island, I should find the material for this great weapon.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
既然知道這裡是德瓦他島，我就應該能找到打造這把神兵的材料了。

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
Ah! the material that I am looking for is Comodo Leather.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
啊！我要找的材料是科摩多龍皮。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Comodo Leather?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
科摩多龍皮？

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
Yes. In the blueprint, it's written that only the recognized few of the Dewata Natives are worthy enough to fight against the Comodo Dragon.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
是的。藍圖上寫著，只有被德瓦他原住民認可的少數人，才有資格與科摩多龍戰鬥。

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
In order to fight the Comodo Dragon, you have to get recognized by the natives. I assume it'll be hard to get the recognition.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
要想挑戰科摩多龍，就必須先獲得原住民的認可。我想這恐怕不容易。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Of course, it must be...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
當然，肯定很困難...

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
Let me ask you a favor. If you get the recognition first, please don't forget to visit me.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
請幫個忙。如果你先獲得了認可，請別忘了來找我。

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
Lady, you possess a strong energy.
Have you seen a monster called a Comodo Dragon on this Island?
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
女士，您身上散發著強大的能量。
您在這座島上見過科摩多龍這種魔物嗎？

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
You possess a strong energy.
Have you seen a monster called a Comodo Dragon on this Island?
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
您身上散發著強大的能量。
您在這座島上見過科摩多龍這種魔物嗎？

scripts.text: Yes, I have.
scripts.translation: 是的，我聽過。

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
Oh! Really?
I'm so lucky to have met you. This is going so well.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
哦！真的嗎？
真幸運能遇到您。事情進展得很順利。

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
Would you please help me?
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
請幫幫我好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
The weapon material that I was looking for is ^0000FFComodo Leather^000000. Bring me 100 of them, and I will make you a fancy weapon.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
我要找的材料是^0000FF科摩多龍皮^000000。請給我100張，我會為您打造一把華麗的武器。

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
I heard Comodo Dragons are very powerful monsters. Please be careful.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
聽說科摩多龍是非常強大的魔物。請務必小心。

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
Did you get recognized by the natives?
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
你獲得原住民的認可了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
I guess not yet. I'm asking around everywhere, but I couldn't find a way to get recognized from natives. I don't know when I could finish making this weapon.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
看來還沒有。我到處打聽，但找不到獲得原住民認可的方法。我不知道什麼時候才能完成這把武器。

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
If you get the recognition before me, please DON'T forget to visit me.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
如果你先於我獲得了認可，請千萬別忘了來找我。

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
So, did you get recognized by the natives?
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
那麼，你獲得原住民的認可了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
Oh yes! Finally.
Lady, you also possess a strong energy.
Did you finally get the recognition from natives?
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
哦，太好了！終於成功了。
女士，您也擁有強大的能量。
您終於獲得原住民的認可了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
Oh yes! Finally.
You also possess a strong energy.
Did you finally get the recognition from natives?
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
哦，太好了！終於成功了。
您也擁有強大的能量。
您終於獲得原住民的認可了嗎？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
Oh! Just as I expected!
I was so lucky to meet you. Everything is going so well.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
哦！正如我所料！
能遇到您真是太幸運了。一切都很順利。

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
I know I have no right to ask you for this, but meeting like this is a destiny...
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
我知道我沒有資格要求您這樣做，但能這樣相遇就是命運...

scripts.text: - Gatti mumbles. -
scripts.translation: - 加蒂低聲嘟囔著。 -

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
The weapon material that I so longed for is ^0000FFComodo Leather^000000. Please get me 100 of them.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
我渴望已久的武器材料是^0000FF科摩多龍皮^000000。請幫我收集100張。

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
I'm so eager to make the weapon in the weapon blueprint.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
我迫不及待地想要製作武器藍圖中的武器。

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
Please, before my passion fades out.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
拜託了，趁我的熱情還未消退之前。

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
Oh! And Comodo Dragon is a very powerful monster, so please be careful.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
哦！而且科摩多龍是非常強大的魔物，請務必小心。

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
By the looks of your walk, you must have brought me 100 Comodo Leather. Hand it over to me.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
看您的樣子，應該是給我帶了100張科摩多龍皮吧。請交給我。

scripts.text: - Gatti takes the Comodo Leather from you. -
scripts.translation: - 加蒂從您手中接過科摩多龍皮。 -

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
So, that is the Comodo Leather. But not enough.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
原來這就是科摩多龍皮。但是數量還不夠。

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
I know I'm asking you a favor, but I need 100 of them.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
我知道是在麻煩您，但我需要100張。

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
Please be careful because Comodo Dragon is very powerful monster. And don't forget to bring me 100 Comodo Leather on your way back.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
科摩多龍是非常強大的魔物，請務必小心。回來時別忘了帶100張科摩多龍皮給我。

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
Oh~ Look at this. How resilient... So soft.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
哦~看看這個。多麼堅韌...多麼柔軟。

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
Comodo Leather is the best material ever.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
科摩多龍皮是最好的材料。

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
Yes, how should I process this?
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
是的，該怎麼處理這個呢？

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
Hmm... Like this?
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
嗯...像這樣？

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
Or like that? Yes! This is the way!
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
還是像那樣？是的！就是這樣！

scripts.text:
- Mastersmith Gatti is enjoying to process the Leathers you've brought to make the weapon. -
- You should wait a little while. -
scripts.translation:
- 神工匠加蒂正興致勃勃地加工你帶來的皮革，準備製作武器。 -
- 請稍等片刻。 -

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well... Gatti?

[Gatti]
Oh! Sorry, sorry! This leather is so interesting.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
啊！抱歉抱歉！這塊皮革太有趣了。

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
I made a hilt out of the leather you brought me.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
我用你帶來的皮革做了一個劍柄。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hilt?

[Gatti]
You don't know what a hilt is? That's what you call the handle of a weapon.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
你不知道什麼是劍柄嗎？那是武器的握柄部分。

scripts.text: - Gatti shows a thing that looks like a handle of a weapon. -
scripts.translation: - 加蒂展示了一個看起來像武器握柄的東西。 -

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
I tried making it like what's written in the blueprint, but I need more material.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
我試著按照圖紙製作，但還需要更多材料。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Really?

[Gatti]
Yes... To be frank with you, I ruined a lot of them trying different things.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
是的...坦白說，我嘗試了各種方法，弄壞了很多。

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
I know this is a lot to ask, but can you get me 100 more Comodo Leather, 20 Steel, and 10 Oridecon?
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
我知道這要求有點多，但你能再幫我弄100張科摩多龍皮、20塊鋼和10塊神之金屬嗎？

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
I'll make you a best weapon ever.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
我會為你打造一把史上最好的武器。

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
Oh! I almost forgot. Don't forget to bring the hilt that I just made you.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
哦！差點忘了。別忘了帶上我剛給你做的劍柄。

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
A weapon must have a handle.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
武器必須有握柄。

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
You brought all the material already?
You were also curious about the finished weapon? Haha.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
材料都帶來了？
你也對成品武器很好奇吧？哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
Hmm... I need more of those. If my ship didn't get wrecked, I could made it on my own, but...
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
嗯...我還需要更多那些東西。如果我的船沒有沉，我本來可以自己做的，但是...

scripts.text: - Gatti mumbles to himself. -
scripts.translation: - 加蒂自言自語。 -

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
100 Comodo Leather, 20 Steel, and 10 Oridecon are what I need.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
我需要100張科摩多龍皮、20塊鋼鐵和10塊神之金屬。

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
If you bring them all, I'll make the best weapon ever.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
如果你把這些都帶來，我會打造出史上最強的武器。

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
Great! We have enough. Wait a little.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
太好了！材料夠了。請稍等片刻。

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
I finished making the weapon. This is called Caress according to the blueprint.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
武器打造完成了。根據圖紙，它的名字叫“愛撫”。

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
I keep finding new stuffs when I lay my eyes on this blueprint.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
每次看這張圖紙，我都能發現一些新的東西。

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
Now, I learned how to make the weapon, ask me any time if you need it.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
現在我已經學會了如何打造這把武器，如果你需要，隨時可以來找我。

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
You're {0},
So, how's the Caress that I made you?
[Gatti]
Yes, yes of course it's great.
I made that weapon so it should be good.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
你是{0}，
我為你打造的“愛撫”感覺如何？
[加蒂]
是的，是的，當然很棒。
畢竟是我打造的武器，肯定很好。

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
You're {0},
So, how's the Caress that I made you?
[Gatti]
You only have a Hilt. You'll need to bring me 10 Oridecon, 20 Steel, and 70 Comodo Leather.

你只有一把劍柄。你需要給我10塊神之金屬、20塊鋼鐵和70張科摩多龍皮。

You're {0},

You have all the materials. Wait just a little.

你是{0}，

你有所有材料。請稍等片刻。

You're {0},

scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
你是{0}，

你想讓我再為你打造一把“愛撫”嗎？那樣的話我需要一把劍柄、50張科摩多龍皮和1根木頭。這些是打造劍柄所需的材料。

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
You're {0},
So, how's the Caress that I made you?
[Gatti]
You brought the material for the Hilt. I'll make it right away.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
你是{0}，
我為你打造的“愛撫”感覺如何？
[加蒂]
你帶來了劍柄的材料。我馬上開始打造。

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
You're {0},
So, how's the Caress that I made you?
[Gatti]
So, you want to reinforce your weapon? The weapon gets broken from time to time during the process, but it doesn't happen that often.
[Gatti]

scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
你是{0}，
我為你打造的“愛撫”感覺如何？
[加蒂]
所以，你想強化你的武器嗎？在強化過程中，武器有時會損壞，但這種情況並不常見。
[加蒂]
如果你想強化“愛撫”，只需給我“愛撫”和100,000 Zeny即可。

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
You're {0},

So, you want to reinforce your weapon? The weapon gets broken from time to time during the process, but it doesn't happen that often.

scripts.translation:

你是{0}，
我為你打造的“愛撫”感覺如何？
[加蒂]
所以，你想強化你的武器嗎？在強化過程中，武器有時會損壞，但這種情況並不常見。
[加蒂]
如果你要做，在強化“愛撫”之前，我得先告訴你一些注意事項。

你是{0}，
我為你打造的“愛撫”感覺如何？

你沒有備齊所有材料。如果沒有所有材料，強化是不可能的。如果你想強化，請帶100,000 Zeny和1把“愛撫”。

[Gatti]
You're {0},
So, how's the Caress that I made you?
[Gatti]
Oh my~~ Almost succeeded... But failed. Sorry, sorry...
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
你是{0}，
我為你打造的“愛撫”感覺如何？
[加蒂]
哎呀~~ 差點就成功了... 但還是失敗了。抱歉，抱歉...

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
You're {0},
So, how's the Caress that I made you?
[Gatti]
Reinforcing the Caress has been successful. See you later.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
你是{0}，
我為你打造的“愛撫”感覺如何？
[加蒂]
“愛撫”強化成功。再見。

scripts.text: It's great!
scripts.translation: 很棒！

scripts.text: I need another Caress.
scripts.translation: 我需要另一把“愛撫”。

scripts.text: Can I make it stronger?
scripts.translation: 能讓我把它變強嗎？

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
If you bring them, I'll make a brand new Caress.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
如果你把這些帶來，我會打造一把全新的“愛撫”。

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
Here is the Caress! Ask me any time.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
這把“愛撫”給你！隨時歡迎再來找我。

Put this here, and process it like this...

把這個放這裡，然後像這樣處理...

給你。如果你帶給我10個神之金屬、20個鋼鐵和70張科摩多龍皮，我就能打造一把“愛撫”。

scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
^FF0000其次！^009977 如果你背包裡有已經強化過或鑲嵌了卡片，但不想強化的“愛撫”，在強化過程中它們可能會損壞，或者強化等級會發生變化。

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
If you don't want that to happen, put the refined Caress elsewhere before the reinforcing.^000000
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
如果你不想發生這種情況，請在強化前把已經強化的“愛撫”放到別處。^000000

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
^FF0000Third!^009977 Sometimes reinforcing fails. The weapon doesn't get destroyed every time you fail. However you should know that the weapon gets destroyed from time to time if you fail.^000000
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
^FF0000第三！^009977 強化有時會失敗。失敗並不總是意味著武器會損壞，但你要知道，如果失敗，武器偶爾會被摧毀。^000000

scripts.text: Please reinforce the weapon.
scripts.translation: 請強化武器

scripts.text: Maybe next time.
scripts.translation: 下次再說

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
Whenever you want to reinforce the Caress, just bring me the Caress and 100,000 zeny.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
當你想強化“愛撫”時，只要帶給我“愛撫”和100,000 Zeny即可。

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
You don't have all the materials. It's impossible to reinforce if you don't have them all. If you want to reinforce, bring 100,000 zeny and 1 Caress.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
你沒有集齊所有材料。如果沒有所有材料，強化是不可能的。如果你想強化，請帶100,000 Zeny和1把“愛撫”。

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
Oh my~~ Almost succeeded... But failed. Sorry, sorry...
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
哎呀~~ 差點就成功了... 但還是失敗了。抱歉，抱歉...

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
Reinforcing the Caress has been successful. See you later.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
“愛撫”強化成功。再見。
